selection: Top-return selected illustrative showcase, not unbiased evaluation; every complete episode counted before selection

config_provenance.digest_note: Digest covers redacted parsed config, not secret-bearing YAML bytes

network_source.trust_note: Explicit source loading executes trusted Python, not a sandbox

checkpoint.soft_q_interpretation: Soft Q predicts entropy-augmented stochastic-policy continuing return, including bootstrap across native TimeLimit. Observed deterministic native reward-to-boundary has a different objective and finite horizon. Their difference is not a calibration error or proof of overestimation.

native_environment.timeout_note: The normal Pendulum-v1 episode boundary is TimeLimit truncation after 200 transitions, not failure
native_environment.diagnostic_note: Upright fraction and final-window settle snapshot are observer diagnostics, never actor inputs or termination rules

episodes.target_definition: Observed discounted native rewards to boundary, no entropy or bootstrap; TimeLimit/caller-cap targets are finite-horizon, not continuing soft-Q targets
episodes.soft_q_interpretation: Soft Q predicts entropy-augmented stochastic-policy continuing return, including bootstrap across native TimeLimit. Observed deterministic native reward-to-boundary has a different objective and finite horizon. Their difference is not a calibration error or proof of overestimation.

upright_diagnostic.definition: Post-transition |wrapped theta| <= 0.1 rad AND |velocity| <= 0.5 rad/s; settle_snapshot means all last 20 observations satisfy this, not lasting control or solved status

summary_all_episodes.timeout_interpretation: Native 200-step TimeLimit is normal, not failure

playback_note: Default stride=1 and fps=20 follow native dt=0.05; changed stride/fps changes playback speed, not trajectory span
encoder_note: Identical consecutive frames can merge while retaining duration; GIF timing is quantized to centiseconds. Counts and duration are read from encoded bytes, not inferred from submitted frames.
